result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that renders mostly well. Found a few minor layout and content issues related to text truncation and inconsistent styling.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the right edge, indicating clipped content rather than proper truncation with ellipsis handling.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontally scrollable card names truncate cleanly with an ellipsis or provide adequate spacing so full names are readable when scrolled.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icons have inconsistent styling — the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a white circle with a dark heart outline, while the pizza card shows a dark circle with a white heart, creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background and color treatment across all restaurant cards for a consistent look.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card is partially cut off by the fold/navigation bar, showing only the top portion of the image and no restaurant details.
issues.suggestion: This is likely expected scroll behavior, but verify the card renders fully when scrolled and that partial content doesn't confuse users.
